_readme: S721 lever (the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever, run 45371224551): Antelope Valley College's 10 programs whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses. Each degree was handed its sister certificate's page (computer-applications-cert-fall-2026 for Computer Applications A.S. 02145), and Electrical Technology certificate 20184 the A.S. page; eLumen heads them 'Computer Applications AS' and 'Computer Applications Cert'. Chemistry A.S.-T 35818 was handed Engineering Fundamentals' certificate page, and the capture's menu listed no Chemistry A.S.-T page. This plan reads each program's own page through the catalog's publish/content call, the call the capture reads (el_pages_fast, heading = the first h1 to h3), and the menu's publish call for every Chemistry address, so a session checks each site_pages pin against the text the capture will read and a test pins it. No model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: What the capture reads on each program's own page: its heading, its course list and its total.
questions.chemistry: Which addresses the menu gives Chemistry, and whether an A.S.-T page exists.
